summary: Ion-ion Coulomb logarithm matching Eq. (18e) of the Sauter et al. EPFL author manuscript LRP 630/99.

capability: Ion-ion Coulomb logarithm from EPFL LRP 630/99 Eq. (18e)
Evaluate the ion-ion Coulomb logarithm in the Sauter et al. author manuscript from temperature, density and charge state.
operation: Evaluate the ion-ion Coulomb logarithm matching EPFL LRP 630/99 Eq. (18e)
discovery.model: EPFL LRP 630/99 author-manuscript Eq. (18e), ln Lambda_ii = 30 - ln(Z^3 sqrt(n_i)/T_i^(3/2)) with n_i in m^-3 and T_i in eV; callable temperature is in keV and charge Z_i maps to manuscript Z.
discovery.geometry: Homogeneous plasma point with all three input arrays broadcast; no spatial geometry is inferred.
discovery.boundary: T_i in keV, n_i in m^-3 and Z_i must be finite and strictly positive.

identity.direction: ion temperature, density and charge -> dimensionless logarithm
identity.definition: 30-0.5*ln(n_i)+1.5*ln(1000*T_i)-3*ln(Z_i), matching EPFL LRP 630/99 author-manuscript Eq. (18e), not NRL 2013 Eq. c. The original uses density in m^-3, temperature in eV and Z^3; the callable uses keV and maps Z to Z_i. Evaluation uses ln(1000)+ln(T), avoiding intermediate overflow/underflow.
identity.model: Ion-ion Coulomb-log relation from EPFL LRP 630/99 author-manuscript Eq. (18e), with explicit SciRel numeric boundary checks
identity.boundary: strictly positive finite T_i in keV, n_i in m^-3, Z_i dimensionless
assumptions: The caller decides whether the weak-coupling estimate is physically adequate.
Charge is a positive scalar or broadcast field, not a species mixture.

inputs.name: T_i
inputs.dtype: real integer/float numeric scalar or array-like; converted to float64
inputs.constraints: finite and strictly positive; nonempty, boolean/string/complex/masked values rejected

inputs.name: n_i
inputs.dtype: real integer/float numeric scalar or array-like; converted to float64
inputs.constraints: finite and strictly positive; nonempty, boolean/string/complex/masked values rejected

inputs.name: Z_i
inputs.dtype: real integer/float numeric scalar or array-like; converted to float64
inputs.constraints: finite and strictly positive; nonempty, boolean/string/complex/masked values rejected

outputs.name: result
outputs.constraints: Finite signed mathematical formula value; physical suitability for a collision model is caller-owned.

preconditions: strictly positive finite T_i in keV, n_i in m^-3, Z_i dimensionless
supported: Finite NumPy evaluation of the declared relation and broadcast shape.
excluded: Whole-transport evolution, experimental calibration, and implicit coordinate reconstruction.
Interpreting zero or negative computed logarithms as valid weakly coupled collision physics; physical calibration or a regime-switching model.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for boolean/string/complex/masked or empty input, non-finite values, malformed or incompatible shape, and the nonpositive or singular domains named by the callable contract.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises FloatingPointError if accepted finite inputs produce an unrepresentable output; no fallback is returned.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; this is a direct algebraic mapping.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No output is returned after an exception.

example.description: Run the relation on a finite declared-domain case.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.physics import calculate_log_lambda_ii
r=calculate_log_lambda_ii(3., 2e19, 2.)
assert np.isfinite(r)

scope: Independent 60-digit Decimal logarithms verify the declared ion-ion relation over temperature/density/charge scales, including smallest subnormal and largest float64; transformation/scaling identities.
Declared failure cases for empty, boolean/string/complex/masked, nonfinite and incompatible inputs.
Agreement with the canonical SciRel callers and dependencies of this relation.
Fixed original constant 30 and the independent quotient in EPFL LRP 630/99 Eq. (18e), including Z^3, verify eV-to-keV input conversion over temperature/density/charge grids and broadcast arrays.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Maintained tests establish the declared ion-ion relation, shapes, numerical boundaries and algebraic agreement with EPFL LRP 630/99 author-manuscript Eq. (18e) after unit conversion. They do not establish global physical calibration or NRL 2013 Eq. c; an independent NRL transcription differs by +0.4388 in ln Lambda. The publisher's final text and the 2002 erratum remain unverified.
known_limitations: No external calibration or collision-frequency composition is claimed.
Only the declared ion-ion relation algebra, original-equation unit conversion and numerical boundaries are covered; this is not a general Coulomb-log model.

This relation is not NRL 2013 Eq. c. An independent transcription of NRL 2013 Eq. c differs by a constant +0.4388 in ln Lambda on probes; the Sauter formula is retained and must not be cited as NRL 2013 Eq. c.

The original scan of Sauter, Angioni and Lin-Liu, EPFL LRP 630/99 (February 1999), printed p. 7 (PDF p. 8), Eq. (18e), was read directly: lnLambda_ii = 30 - ln(Z^3 sqrt(n_i)/T_i^(3/2)), densities in m^-3 and temperatures in eV; institutional author-manuscript record https://infoscience.epfl.ch/handle/20.500.14299/23214. Its Z maps to the callable's Z_i, producing -3 ln(Z_i).

Verification establishes occurrence in the institutional author manuscript only, not derivation, experimental calibration or arbitrary ion-mixture applicability. The publisher's final typesetting and the 2002 erratum remain unverified (UNKNOWN). It does not verify ee constant 31.0, Wesson attribution or the physical origin of the e-i/NRL difference (all UNKNOWN).

basis.statement: Independent 60-digit Decimal logarithms verify the declared ion-ion relation over temperature, density and charge scales, including the smallest subnormal and the largest float64.
